D: The rebels flee to the ice planet Hoth and Luke trains with Yoda.
P: Serve the stew when Yoda cooks rootleaf stew for Luke.
S: Shaved ice with homemade raspberry syrup tinted blue
Shaved ice packed into cups, soaked with homemade blue raspberry syrup (raspberries simmered with sugar, strained, a drop of blue).
warm on the inside, which beats the outside

Flaky hand pies packed with chuck braised in stout with mushrooms and thyme, baked golden and served with a sharp horseradish and mustard dip. Brown 600g diced chuck in batches, add 1 diced onion and 200g sliced mushrooms, then 1 tbsp flour, 330ml stout, 200ml beef stock and thyme. Cover and simmer 2 hours until thick and tender, then cool. Cut 8 rounds from 4 sheets shortcrust for bases and 8 lids from 2 sheets puff. Fill, seal, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Mix 100g sour cream with 2 tsp horseradish and 1 tsp Dijon.
Baked spinach, artichoke and cream cheese dip with corn chips
Warm spinach and artichoke dip with cream cheese, sour cream, mozzarella and parmesan, baked at 190C for 20 minutes. Corn chips.
M: Parsnip, carrot, swede, celeriac and potato stew with miso, crusty bread
Parsnip, carrot, swede, celeriac and potato simmered in a rich vegetable stock with thyme, bay and a spoon of miso, finished with parsley. Crusty bread.
a fancy dinner table, with Vader waiting at the end of it

Seared eye fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and golden puff pastry, carved pink with red wine jus and buttery mash. Season a 1kg eye fillet, sear all over and brush with Dijon. Cook 400g finely chopped mushrooms with 2 shallots and thyme until dry. Lay 8 slices prosciutto on cling film, spread with the mushrooms, roll the beef up tight and chill 20 minutes. Wrap in 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and chill 20 minutes. Bake at 220C for 25 minutes until 52C inside and rest 10 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock for jus. Serve with mash.
W: Vanilla ice cream frozen in a block, coated in dark chocolate and sliced
Slab of vanilla ice cream frozen hard in a loaf tin, coated in dark chocolate shell, sliced thick.
K: Peach nectar and orange juice topped with sparkling water, no alcohol
Peach nectar and orange juice topped with sparkling water, the colour of the clouds over Cloud City.

s.note: Shaved ice with homemade raspberry syrup tinted blue
s.how: Simmer 250g raspberries with 150g sugar and 100ml water for 10 minutes, strain and cool, then add a drop of blue colouring. Pack shaved or crushed ice into four cups and pour the syrup over.

s.note: Baked spinach, artichoke and cream cheese dip with corn chips
s.how: Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with a jar of chopped marinated artichokes, 250g cream cheese, 100g sour cream and 50g grated parmesan. Top with 100g mozzarella and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Serve with corn chips.

m.note: Parsnip, carrot, swede, celeriac and potato stew with miso, crusty bread
m.how: Soften 1 onion in oil, then add 2 parsnips, 2 carrots, half a swede, half a celeriac and 2 potatoes, all in chunks. Pour in 1.25L vegetable stock with thyme and a bay leaf and simmer 35 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp miso paste, scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream frozen in a block, coated in dark chocolate and sliced
w.how: Press 1L softened vanilla ice cream into a loaf tin lined with baking paper and freeze hard overnight. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 3 tbsp coconut oil. Turn out the slab, pour the chocolate over and let it set. Slice thick.

d.note: Peach nectar and orange juice topped with sparkling water, no alcohol
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 120ml peach nectar and 60ml orange juice to each and top with 100ml sparkling water. Garnish with a peach slice on the rim.
